name: DUMBBELL BENT LEG TWIST
introduce:
Lie on your back with your knees up at 90 degrees. Cross your calves and put a dumbbell between them.

Extend your arms to the sides on the ground with your palms down. Twist your legs to the left while keeping your upper body in place.

Slowly return and twist to the other side. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please tighten your abs during the entire exercise.
Please keep your knees at 90 degrees.
Please control the speed, don\'t use momentum.
Keep your upper body in place when twisting your legs.
